title: Japanese Beef Shin Ramen
description: A hearty, comforting bowl of Japanese beef shin ramen, made with rich pork broth, springy noodles, and tender beef shin.
instructions: 1. In a large pot, combine pork bones, beef broth, water, and soy sauce. Bring to a boil over high heat.
2. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 2 hours, or until the broth is rich and flavorful.
3. In a separate pot, cook the ramen noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
4. In a large skillet or wok, cook the sliced beef shin over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through.
5. Add the cooked noodles to the skillet or wok and stir to combine with the beef and broth.
6. Season the broth with sugar and soy sauce to taste.
7. Divide the noodles and beef among individual bowls.
8. Ladle the hot broth over the top and garnish with green onions, sesame seeds, and sliced scallions.
10. For an added rich and savory flavor, drizzle with sesame oil and sprinkle with grated ginger.
